in_sanskrit.name: Karuppasamy
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Cure
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Karuppasamy एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Karuppasamy is a Tamil name derived from the Tamil word 'karuppu' which means 'wounded' or 'sick'. The name is believed to be a divine name for the god of cure or healing. Karuppasamy is often depicted as a form of Lord Murugan or Lord Subramaniam, who is the god of war, medicine, and fertility.
